'''Sebastião Bocalom Rodrigues''' (May 18, 1953), better known as '''Tião Bocalom''', is a [[Brazilians|Brazilian]] [[mathematician]] and [[politician]] affiliated with the [[Brazilian Social Democracy Party]] (PSDB).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Martins |first=Saimo |date=July 2, 2026 |title=Bocalom: “Jorge Viana planta café e não seringueira porque sabe que dá dinheiro” |url=https://ac24horas.com/2026/06/02/bocalom-jorge-viana-planta-cafe-e-nao-seringueira-porque-sabe-o-que-da-dinheiro/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260603071405/https://ac24horas.com/2026/06/02/bocalom-jorge-viana-planta-cafe-e-nao-seringueira-porque-sabe-o-que-da-dinheiro/ |archive-date=June 3, 2026 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=ac24horas |language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=March 19, 2026 |title=Acabou o mistério: Ao lado de Aécio Neves, Bocalom se filia e vai ser candidato ao governo pelo PSDB |url=https://portalacre.com.br/2026/03/acabou-o-misterio-ao-lado-de-aecio-neves-bocalom-se-filia-e-vai-ser-candidato-ao-governo-pelo-psdb/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/Oi4Qx |archive-date=August 1, 2026 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=Portal Acre |language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Souza |first=Felipe |date=October 19, 2024 |title=Quem é Tião Bocalom, reeleito prefeito em Rio Branco |url=https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/eleicoes/quem-e-tiao-bocalom-reeleito-prefeito-em-rio-branco/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241206092048/https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/eleicoes/quem-e-tiao-bocalom-reeleito-prefeito-em-rio-branco/ |archive-date=December 6, 2024 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[CNN Brasil]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref> He served as mayor of [[Rio Branco, Acre|Rio Branco]], the capital of the state of [[Acre (state)|Acre]], from 2021 to 2026, having been elected in {{Interlanguage link|2020 Rio Branco mayoral election|lt=2020|pt|Eleição municipal de Rio Branco em 2020}} and reelected in the [[2024 Rio Branco mayoral election|2024]] election.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |date=March 26, 2026 |title=Tião Bocalom renuncia à prefeitura para disputar governo do Acre |url=https://g1.globo.com/ac/acre/eleicoes/2026/noticia/2026/03/26/tiao-bocalom-formaliza-renuncia-a-prefeitura-de-rio-branco-para-disputar-governo-do-acre-em-2026.ghtml |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260507120859/https://g1.globo.com/ac/acre/eleicoes/2026/noticia/2026/03/26/tiao-bocalom-formaliza-renuncia-a-prefeitura-de-rio-branco-para-disputar-governo-do-acre-em-2026.ghtml |archive-date=May 7, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[G1 (website)|G1]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref> In April 2026, he resigned from the mayor’s office to run for governor in the {{Interlanguage link|2026 Acre gubernatorial election|lt=October election|pt|Eleições estaduais no Acre em 2026}} of that same year.<ref name=":4" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=August 1, 2026 |title=Federação PSDB-Cidadania oficializa candidatura de Tião Bocalom ao governo do Acre == Biography ==

=== First years and education ===
Sebastião was born in [[Bela Vista do Paraíso]], a city located in the interior of the state of [[Paraná (state)|Paraná]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Leite |first=Alexandre |date=July 26, 2026 |title=Conheça a carreira política de Tião Bocalom, pré-candidato ao Governo do Acre |url=https://www.itatiaia.com.br/politica/eleicoes/conheca-a-carreira-politica-de-tiao-bocalom-pre-candidato-ao-governo-do-acre/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/sMfbX |archive-date=August 1, 2026 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=[[Rádio Itatiaia]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Ficha do candidato a prefeito Tião Bocalom - PP - Rio Branco AC {{!}} Eleições 2020 {{!}} Folha |url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/eleicoes/candidatos/2020/ac/prefeito/tiao-bocalom-10001003637.shtml |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220816023528/https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/eleicoes/candidatos/2020/ac/prefeito/tiao-bocalom-10001003637.shtml |archive-date=August 16, 2022 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=[[Folha de S.Paulo]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref> He moved to [[Mandaguari]], also in the interior of Paraná, where he earned a degree in [[mathematics]] from the Mandaguari School of Philosophy, Sciences, and Letters.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Lei de Acesso à Informação {{!}} PREFEITO |url=https://cgm.riobranco.ac.gov.br/lai/institucional/prefeito/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260314132823/https://cgm.riobranco.ac.gov.br/lai/institucional/prefeito/ |archive-date=March 14, 2026 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=Município do Rio Branco}}</ref> After graduating, he began working as a math teacher.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Carvalho |first=Mirielle |date=October 6, 2024 |title=Resultado Eleições prefeito em Rio Branco - Tião Bocalom, do PL, é reeleito - JOTA |url=https://www.jota.info/eleicoes/eleicoes-2024/tiao-bocalom-do-pl-e-reeleito-prefeito-de-rio-branco |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260607142940/https://www.jota.info/eleicoes/eleicoes-2024/tiao-bocalom-do-pl-e-reeleito-prefeito-de-rio-branco |archive-date=June 7, 2026 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=JOTA Jornalismo |language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Ramos |first=Caio |date=July 31, 2026 |title=Acre: coligação confirma Tião Bocalom ao governo e Velloso ao Senado |url=https://www.metropoles.com/brasil/acre-coligacao-confirma-tiao-bocalom-ao-governo-e-velloso-ao-senado |url-status=live |archive-date=August 1, 2026 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=[[Metrópoles]] |language=pt-BR|archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/zJ2yV}}</ref>

=== Politics ===
He began his political career in the city of [[Nova Olímpia, Paraná|Nova Olímpia]], in the interior of Paraná, as a member of the [[Democratic Social Party]] (PDS).<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=September 19, 2006 |title=Candidatos - Governador - Acre - Tião Bocalom |url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/folha/especial/2006/eleicoes/candidatos-governador-ac-tiao_bocalom.shtml |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241217095259/https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/folha/especial/2006/eleicoes/candidatos-governador-ac-tiao_bocalom.shtml |archive-date=December 17, 2024 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=[[Folha de S. Paulo]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=Renato Carvalho recebe o prefeito de Rio Branco Tião Bocalom |url=https://araguari.mg.gov.br/noticias/renato-carvalho-recebe-o-prefeito-de-rio-branco-tiao-bocalom |url-status=live |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/Zhk13 |archive-date=August 1, 2026 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=Prefeitura Municipal de Araguari |language=pt-br}}</ref> In the 1982 election, he was elected city councilor after receiving 166 votes, making him the second-highest vote-getter in the election.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Eleição de 15/11/1982 |url=https://apps.tre-pr.jus.br/internet2/downloadResultado?RESULTADOS_ELEICOES/19821115A79677.pdf |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.org/details/resultados-eleicoes-19821115-a-79677 |archive-date=August 1, 2026 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=Tribunal Regional Eleitoral do Paraná}}</ref> In 1986, he went to the state of [[Acre (state)|Acre]] on vacation and was invited to start a lumber business, where he settled with his family the following year.<ref name=":1" /> A resident of Acre and a member of the [[Reform Progressive Party]] (PPR), he became, in 1993, the first mayor of the city of [[Acrelândia]], which had been founded in 1992.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Galeria de ex-Prefeitos |url=https://www.acrelandia.ac.gov.br/paginas/ex-prefeitos |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260308072945/https://www.acrelandia.ac.gov.br/paginas/ex-prefeitos |archive-date=March 8, 2026 |access-date=August 1, 2026 |website=[[Acrelândia]] |language=pt}}</ref> He served as mayor until 1996.<ref name=":2" />  He served as State Secretary of Agriculture for the State of Acre from January 1999 to May 2000, during [[Jorge Viana]]’s ([[Workers' Party (Brazil)|PT]]) administration.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Melo |first=Ray |date=June 12, 2026 |title="Quem falava só em florestania agora planta café”, dispara Bocalom em referência a Jorge Viana |url=https://noticiasdahora.com.br/politica/quem-falava-so-em-florestania-agora-planta-cafe-dispara-bocalom-em-referencia-a-jorge-viana/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://megalodon.jp/2026-0803-0055-56/https://noticiasdahora.com.br:443/politica/quem-falava-so-em-florestania-agora-planta-cafe-dispara-bocalom-em-referencia-a-jorge-viana/ |archive-date=August 2, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=Notícias da Hora |language=pt-BR}}</ref>

In 2000, as a member of the [[Brazilian Social Democracy Party]] (PSDB), he ran again for mayor of Acrelândia.<ref name=":3" /> He was elected, becoming mayor of Acrelândia once again until 2004.<ref name=":3" /> In 2004, he ran for mayor again. He was elected after receiving more than 2,000 votes.<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":5">{{Cite web |title=Placar AC/ Acrelandia |url=https://eventos.noticias.uol.com.br/eleicoes/AC/index-01120.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://megalodon.jp/2026-0802-2246-09/https://eventos.noticias.uol.com.br:443/eleicoes/AC/index-01120.html |archive-date=August 2, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[Universo Online]]}}</ref> He resigned from his position on March 24, 2006, to run for governor of Acre.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Azedo |first=Luis |last2=Krieger |first2=Gustavo |date=July 7, 2006 |title=Alianças repetidas |url=https://memoria.bn.gov.br/DocReader/DocReader.aspx?bib=028274_05&pesq=%22Ti%C3%A3o%20Bocalom%22&pasta=ano%20200&pagfis=133691 |journal=[[Correio Braziliense]] |issue=15754 |pages=4}}</ref> Running as a candidate for the PSDB in the {{Interlanguage link|2006 Acre gubernatorial election|lt=2006 election|pt|Eleições estaduais no Acre em 2006}}, he finished in third place in a race won by [[Binho Marques]] (PT).<ref>{{Cite web |date=October 1, 2006 |title=Candidato do PT, Binho Marques vence no 1º turno no Acre |url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/folha/brasil/ult96u84453.shtml |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260802135336/https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/folha/brasil/ult96u84453.shtml |archive-date=August 2, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[Folha de S. Paulo]]}}</ref> In the 2008 municipal elections, he ran for mayor of Rio Branco, the capital of the state of Acre, as a candidate for the PSDB.<ref>{{Cite web |date=August 12, 2008 |title=Rio Branco tem três candidatos sem gastos ou despesas; Veja contas de outras capitais |url=https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/eleicoes-2008/rio-branco-tem-tres-candidatos-sem-gastos-ou-despesas-veja-contas-de-outras-capitais-5009483 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260802135926/https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/eleicoes-2008/rio-branco-tem-tres-candidatos-sem-gastos-ou-despesas-veja-contas-de-outras-capitais-5009483 |archive-date=August 2, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[O Globo]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref name=":6">{{Cite web |title=Folha Online - Especial - Eleições - Perfil dos candidatos - Rio Branco: Tião Bocalom |url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/folha/especial/2008/eleicoes/prefeitos/ac-rio_branco-45-1.shtml |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240605215940/https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/folha/especial/2008/eleicoes/prefeitos/ac-rio_branco-45-1.shtml |archive-date=June 5, 2024 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[Folha de S. Paulo]]}}</ref> Tião finished the election in third place, in a race won by {{Interlanguage link|Raimundo Angelim|lt=Raimundo Angelim|pt|Raimundo Angelim }} (PT).<ref name=":6" /> 

In the [[2010 Acre gubernatorial election|2010 elections]], he ran again for governor of Acre as a candidate for the PSDB. This time, he formed a broad coalition with [[Brazilian Democratic Movement]] (PMDB), [[Democrats (Brazil)|Democrats]] (DEM), [[Social Liberal Party (Brazil)|Social Liberal Party]] (PSL), [[Social Christian Party (Brazil)|Social Christian Party]] (PSC), [[Popular Socialist Party (Brazil)|Popular Socialist Party]] (PPS), [[National Mobilization Party]] (PMN) [[Labour Party of Brazil]] (PTdoB) and managed to secure 49.18% of the valid votes in the first round, but was defeated by candidate [[Tião Viana]] (PT), who secured 50.51% and won the election in the first round.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tião Bocalom: 2010 |url=https://divulgacandcontas.tse.jus.br/divulga/#/candidato/NORTE/AC/14417/10000000130/2010/AC |url-status=live |archive-url=https://megalodon.jp/hashbang/1yDsB |archive-date=August 2, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[Superior Electoral Court]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Martins |first=Gabrielly |date=June 24, 2026 |title=Tião Viana rebate Bocalom sobre eleição de 2010: "Gosta de inventar mentirinhas" |url=https://agazetadoacre.com/2026/07/noticias/politica/tiao-viana-rebate-bocalom-sobre-eleicao-de-2010-gosta-de-inventar-mentirinhas/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260725073140/https://agazetadoacre.com/2026/07/noticias/politica/tiao-viana-rebate-bocalom-sobre-eleicao-de-2010-gosta-de-inventar-mentirinhas/ |archive-date=July 25, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=A Gazeta do Acre |language=pt-BR}}</ref> In the end, the margin between the candidates was less than 5,000 votes, making it one of the closest gubernatorial elections in modern Brazilian history.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Alencastro |first=Catarina |date=October 4, 2010 |title=Tião Viana vence a eleição no Acre com pequena vantagem |url=https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/eleicoes-2010/tiao-viana-vence-eleicao-no-acre-com-pequena-vantagem-4986251 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/afQPU |archive-date=August 2, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[O Globo]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Lindoso |first=Kerolayne |date=August 17, 2026 |title=Bocalom chega ao Juruá e relembra eleição de 2010: "Perdemos por meio por cento" |url=https://opalaciano.com.br/acre/bocalom-chega-ao-jurua-e-relembra-eleicao-de-2010-perdemos-por-meio-por-cento/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/WtuUO |archive-date=August 2, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=O Palaciano |language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=October 28, 2012 |title=PT vence em SP; PSB fica com 5 capitais e PSDB com 4 |url=https://www.bbc.com/portuguese/noticias/2012/10/121026_live_page_segundo_turno |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250715095049/https://www.bbc.com/portuguese/noticias/2012/10/121026_live_page_segundo_turno |archive-date=July 15, 2025 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[BBC News Brasil]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref>

In the 2012 municipal elections, he ran for mayor of the capital, Rio Branco, also as a candidate for the PSDB, and advanced to the runoff against candidate {{Interlanguage link|Marcus Alexandre|lt=Marcus Alexandre|pt|Marcus Alexandre }} (PT).<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |last2= |first2= |date=October 26, 2012 |title=Marcus tem 53%, e Tião Bocalom, 47% dos válidos em Rio Branco, diz Ibope |url=https://g1.globo.com/politica/eleicoes/2012/noticia/2012/10/marcus-tem-53-e-tiao-bocalom-47-dos-validos-em-rio-branco-diz-ibope.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260213192801/https://g1.globo.com/politica/eleicoes/2012/noticia/2012/10/marcus-tem-53-e-tiao-bocalom-47-dos-validos-em-rio-branco-diz-ibope.html |archive-date=February 13, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[G1 (website)|G1]] |language=pt-br}}</ref> While he received 43.85% of the vote in the first round, he secured 49.81% of the valid votes in the runoff, losing by a margin of fewer than 3,000 votes.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Diniz |first=Marcela |date=October 28, 2012 |title=Marcus Alexandre vence eleição para prefeito de Rio Branco |url=https://www12.senado.leg.br/radio/1/noticia/2012/10/28/marcus-alexandre-vence-eleicao-para-prefeito-de-rio-branco |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240715001501/https://www12.senado.leg.br/radio/1/noticia/2012/10/28/marcus-alexandre-vence-eleicao-para-prefeito-de-rio-branco |archive-date=July 15, 2024 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[Rádio Senado]] |language=pt-br}}</ref>  In the [[2014 Acre gubernatorial election|2014 elections]], for the third consecutive time, Tião Bocalom ran for governor of Acre.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Vaz |first=Roberto |date=August 5, 2013 |title=Tião Bocalom poderá deixar o PSDB e disputar o Governo do Acre pelo PPS |url=https://ac24horas.com/2013/08/05/tiao-bocalom-podera-deixar-o-psdb-e-disputar-o-governo-do-acre-pelo-pps/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181021081626/https://ac24horas.com/2013/08/05/tiao-bocalom-podera-deixar-o-psdb-e-disputar-o-governo-do-acre-pelo-pps/ |archive-date=October 21, 2018 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=Ac24horas |language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=August 30, 2013 |title=Com os dois pés no DEM, Bocalom diz que sai “de coração partido” do PSDB |url=https://ac24horas.com/2013/08/30/na-tv-bocalom-revela-que-sai-de-coracao-partido-do-psdb-e-que-ainda-nao-sabe-se-saira-candidato-ao-governo/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181022023628/https://ac24horas.com/2013/08/30/na-tv-bocalom-revela-que-sai-de-coracao-partido-do-psdb-e-que-ainda-nao-sabe-se-saira-candidato-ao-governo/ |archive-date=October 22, 2018 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=Ac24horas |language=pt-BR}}</ref> However, he ran as a candidate for the DEM, while the PSDB fielded another candidate: [[Márcio |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140924195949/https://g1.globo.com/ac/acre/eleicoes/2014/noticia/2014/06/convencao-oficializa-candidatura-de-marcio-bittar-ao-governo-do-acre.html |archive-date=September 24, 2014 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[G1 (website)|G1]] |language=pt-br}}</ref> In addition to the DEM, its coalition included the PMN and the [[Green Party (Brazil)|Green Party]] (PV).<ref name=":7" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Fulgêncio |first=Caio |date=September 18, 2014 |title='Se não roubar, o dinheiro dá', diz Tião Bocalom (DEM) sobre gestão |url=https://g1.globo.com/ac/acre/eleicoes/2014/noticia/2014/09/se-nao-roubar-o-dinheiro-da-diz-tiao-bocalom-dem-sobre-gestao.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260802143949/https://g1.globo.com/ac/acre/eleicoes/2014/noticia/2014/09/se-nao-roubar-o-dinheiro-da-diz-tiao-bocalom-dem-sobre-gestao.html |archive-date=August 2, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[G1 (website)|G1]] |language=pt-br}}</ref> Bocalom finished in third place in an election won by Tião Vianna.<ref name=":8">{{Cite web |title=Acre - Governador - 1º Turno - Apuração - Eleições - 2014 - Especial - Poder - Folha de S.Paulo |url=https://eleicoes.folha.uol.com.br/2014/1turno/governador/ac.shtml |url-status=live Paulo]]}}</ref>

After deciding to support [[Jair Bolsonaro|Jair Bolsonaro’s]] [[Jair Bolsonaro 2018 presidential campaign|presidential]] bid, he joined the PSL to run in the 2018 elections.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=January 6, 2022 |title=Símbolo da eleição de 2018, acreano Tico Bolsonaro deixa PSL e vai para o PL |url=https://acrenews.com.br/simbolo-da-eleicao-de-2018-acreano-tico-bolsonaro-deixa-psl-e-vai-para-o-pl/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250216152711/https://acrenews.com.br/simbolo-da-eleicao-de-2018-acreano-tico-bolsonaro-deixa-psl-e-vai-para-o-pl/ |archive-date=February 16, 2025 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=AcreNews |language=pt-BR}}</ref> This time, he chose to run for federal deputy. After the polls closed, it became clear that he had failed to win a seat due to the electoral coefficient.<ref>{{Cite web |date=November 30, 2020 |title=O fim de uma saga: Bocalom perdeu seis eleições antes da vitória; relembre |url=https://contilnetnoticias.com.br/politica/o-fim-de-uma-saga-bocalom-perdeu-seis-eleicoes-antes-da-vitoria-relembre/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260802145017/https://contilnetnoticias.com.br/politica/o-fim-de-uma-saga-bocalom-perdeu-seis-eleicoes-antes-da-vitoria-relembre/ |archive-date=August 2, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=ContilNet Notícias |language=pt-BR}}</ref> He was the third-highest-voted candidate for federal deputy in the city of Rio Branco and the highest-voted candidate in the city of Acrelândia, where he had served as mayor.<ref name=":9">{{Cite web |date=July 10, 2018 |title=Votação para Tião Bocalom no Acre {{!}} Eleições 2018 |url=https://especiais.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2018/resultados/municipios-acre/deputado-federal-candidato-tiao-bocalom-1717/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210411210021/https://especiais.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2018/resultados/municipios-acre/deputado-federal-candidato-tiao-bocalom-1717/ |archive-date=April 11, 2021 |access-date=August 2, 2022 |website=[[Gazeta do Povo]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref> However, even though he was the fifth-highest-voted candidate in the state, he failed to win a seat.<ref name=":9" /> 

In the {{Interlanguage link|2020 Rio Branco mayoral election|lt=2020 municipal elections|pt|Eleição municipal de Rio Branco em 2020}}, he ran again for mayor of Rio Branco.<ref name=":10">{{Cite web |archive-date=December 31, 2025 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[G1 (website)|G1]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref> This time, as a member of the [[Progressistas]] (PP), he received 49.58% of the valid |url-status=live |archive-date=August 2, 2026 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[Estado de Minas]] |language=pt-BR|archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/Fnqvh}}</ref> In the runoff election prefeito de Rio Branco |url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2020/11/tiao-bocalom-e-eleito-prefeito-de-rio-branco.shtml |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251220074429/https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2020/11/tiao-bocalom-e-eleito-prefeito-de-rio-branco.shtml |archive-date=December 20, 2025 |access-date=August 2, 2026 |website=[[Folha de S.Paulo]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref> According to a report by ''[[G1 (website)|G1]]'', the [[Grupo Globo|Grupo Globo's]] online news portal, he has fulfilled only one of his 49 campaign promises in his first year in office; the politician claims that the low number is due to the economic effects of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil|COVID-19 pandemic]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=January 4, 2022 |title=Em um ano de mandato, Bocalom cumpriu totalmente uma das 49 promessas feitas durante a campanha == Personal life ==

2021 |title=Esposa do prefeito de Rio Branco, Tião Bocalom, morre após 6 anos lutando contra doença degenerativa
